benchmark.taxonomy_overlap_policy: Categories must represent capabilities absent from the frozen 77-intent BANKING77 taxonomy. Exact text overlap with train or validation is forbidden.

calibration_evaluation.per_fold_rule: Fit temperature on four validation folds. Score the held-out in-domain fold and the entire frozen OOS set using that same fitted temperature.
calibration_evaluation.aggregate_rule: Report validation-row-count weighted mean of fold AUROC and fold in-domain FPR at declared OOS recall, plus fold range.
calibration_evaluation.full_validation_temperature_role: production-configuration diagnostic only; not the primary OOS performance estimate

metrics.fpr_threshold_rule: Within each fold, use the empirical OOS-score 0.05 quantile with lower order statistic; classify OOS when score >= threshold. This metric-specific threshold is diagnostic and is not the final operating threshold.

selection.purpose: Compare OOS separation of the surviving calibrated A1 reference and calibrated A2 candidate without using the full-validation calibrator on its own fitting rows for the primary estimate.
